run_franka_arm_demo: run the FrankaArm demo with argparse to connect to a robot and execute random joint motion
create_joint_pd_policy: create a JointPDPolicy class that performs PD control around a desired joint position using torchcontrol
connect_franka_arm: connect a FrankaArm instance to a robot server by sending a PD policy via RobotInterface
apply_joint_commands: apply desired joint position commands to a connected FrankaArm robot using apply_commands
get_franka_sensors: get the current joint angles from a FrankaArm robot using the get_sensors method
